dataset: Mind Your Swing — Mallorca Golf FINAL
scope: 20 Mallorca layouts currently targeted by the Mind Your Swing local database.

method.primary_source: Real Federación Española de Golf (RFEG) current club cards
method.secondary_official_source: Son Antem Golf official West course scorecard
method.rule: No missing values are invented. When the official current card did not expose a field cleanly, the value is left null or the source is explicitly noted.

notes: This file contains ONE verified reference tee/layout per field, not every possible tee.
Pollença is stored as a 9-hole layout because the current RFEG card is 9 holes and the 18-hole view repeats the nine.
Son Antem West uses the club's official scorecard for hole distances/HCP/par; its web page lists current tee totals and rating/slope.

The dataset intentionally excludes Santa Ponsa II, Santa Ponsa III and Palma Pitch & Putt because Claude's current database was reported as containing 20 real fields and those are not part of that 20-row target.

courses.name: Golf Pollença
courses.notes: RFEG current card exposes the 9-hole card (Par 35, 2,608 m on the outbound). The same 9 holes are repeated for an 18-hole calculation. Stored as the underlying 9-hole layout; Course Rating/Slope are not copied from the duplicated 18-hole calculation here.

courses.name: Golf Son Antem West
courses.notes: Hole distances and HCP/par are from the club's official West scorecard PDF; club webpage confirms the current West tee totals and rating/slope family. White reference used here.

courses.name: Son Quint
courses.notes: RFEG current club page exposes the 18-hole Son Quint card with these values; sex/tee-color metadata is left neutral here because the accessible text does not label the selected 18-hole card consistently.
